event.title: Shooting in Krakow's Main Market Square Leaves Six Dead and Over a Dozen Injured
event.canonical_title: Shooting in Krakow's Main Market Square Leaves Six Dead and Over a Dozen Injured
event.summary: A shooting incident in the Main Market Square of Krakow, Poland, resulted in six fatalities and at least 15 injuries. The gunman, a Polish citizen, reportedly opened fire from his car before being shot and wounded by police. Authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding this tragic event, which is notable as mass shootings are rare in Poland.

timeline.title: Six Killed in Krakow Shooting Linked to Far-Right Ideologies
timeline.summary: A mass shooting in Krakow left six people dead, including a British national, and injured at least 17 others. The 24-year-old Polish gunman, who reportedly had far-right affiliations, was critically injured during his arrest. Authorities have launched a terrorism investigation as they explore the suspect's extremist motives. Additionally, three bodies were discovered at the gunman's home, raising further concerns about the incident.
key_facts: Six people killed, including a British national.
At least 17 others injured in the shooting.
The suspect is a 24-year-old Polish man with far-right affiliations.
A terrorism investigation has been launched.
Three bodies were found at the suspect's home.

timeline.title: Poland Observes Mourning After Deadly Krakow Shooting
timeline.summary: Poland has entered two days of national mourning following a mass shooting in Krakow, where a 24-year-old man with far-right views opened fire in a busy central square, resulting in six deaths and 15 injuries. Authorities have launched a terror investigation and discovered the bodies of the suspect's parents and sister at his home.

event_overview.title: About Krakow Shooting
event_overview.subject: Krakow Shooting
event_overview.summary: The Krakow shooting was a gun attack on 7 November 2026 in and around the Main Market Square in Krakow’s Old Town, Poland. Authorities reported six people killed and multiple people injured; the suspected attacker was shot and detained by police, while prosecutors opened a terrorism-related investigation.

facts.label: Date and location
facts.value: The attack occurred shortly after 3 p.m. on 7 November 2026 near Sławkowska Street by Krakow’s Main Market Square (Rynek Główny).

facts.label: Casualties
facts.value: Krakow city authorities reported six deaths and 15 injuries in the shooting.

facts.label: Suspect and police response
facts.value: The city said the alleged attacker, identified by police as a Polish citizen, was shot and detained by officers after the incident.

facts.label: Investigation
facts.value: The National Prosecutor’s Office opened an investigation covering the killing of six people in Krakow and attempted killings of others, including police officers; prosecutors described the Krakow act as a terrorism-related crime.

facts.label: Official mourning
facts.value: Poland declared national mourning for 8–9 November 2026 in tribute to the victims; Krakow separately announced city mourning through 11 November.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected timeline follows the shooting, the initial official assessment of possible far-right motives, and mourning measures, but does not attempt to cover every investigative development, victim update, or related incident.
